name: Thief II: The Metal Age
description: Thief II: The Metal Age is a singleplayer first-person stealth and immersive sim game and the second in the Thief series.

steam.store_details: The original build, without the NewDark engine patch.
steam.patches: T2Fix bundles the NewDark engine patch along with a range of modern-system fixes, and is worth installing alongside EAX.

gog.store_details: It comes with the NewDark engine patch pre-installed.

audio_settings.title: Enable underwater reverb
audio_settings.reason: Some Thief II maps don't mark their underwater areas, so they play the wrong reverb there.

optional_settings.title: Enable full-precision mouse look
optional_settings.reason: Thief II reads mouse look through standard Windows input by default, which doesn't give high-resolution mice their full precision.
